tara: Marketing needs short (~100 char) and long (~300 char) quote variants + final image sizes: 1200x628 hero, 280x280 tile.

maria: Emailed AstraGrid requesting approval and brand hexes. Asking them to reply with "OK to publish" and full name/title.

partner-bot: Reminder scheduled in 48h to follow up if no reply.
